title.text: Consult engine — the doctor's screen as settings, not code

walk.text:
Walk it:
1 · The brief opens for the called token. The visit type is the big badge: REVISIT, NEW (Call next) or RENEWAL (Call next again). The desk complaint is in the patient's words.
2 · Start consultation → board 2. The desk words are already chips. Move between the tabs: the 'Your work so far' strip stays on top and fills as you enter things. Tabs with entries get a dot.
• Prescription: each medicine has a small stock tag in its top-right corner. Add Amlong 5 (0 in stock) to see the alternative in the right pane.
• Save draft in the header; autosave time updates on every change.
3 · The Summary tab of a finished visit.

why.text:
Owner's five tests on every board: accuracy, speed, auditable, compliant, dashboard UX.

Comment on any board to rule on it.
